{{Short description|Dutch chemist (1934–2020)}}
'''George Blasse''' (28 August 1934 – 30 December 2020) was a Dutch chemist. He was a professor of [[solid-state chemistry]] at [[Utrecht University]] for most of his career.

Blasse was born on 28 August 1934 in [[Amsterdam]].<ref name=uu>{{cite web|url=https://profs.library.uu.nl/index.php/profrec/getprofdata/187/15/209/0 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201024124534/https://profs.library.uu.nl/index.php/profrec/getprofdata/187/15/209/0 |title=Prof.dr. G. Blasse (1934 - ) |language=Dutch |publisher=Utrecht University |date= |archive-date=24 October 2020}}</ref> He studied chemistry at the [[University of Amsterdam]]. In 1964 he obtained his PhD under E.W. Gorter at [[Leiden University]] with a dissertation titled: ''Chrystal chemistry and some magnetic properties of mixed metal oxides with spinel structure.'' From 1960 to 1970 Blasse was employed by the [[Philips Natuurkundig Laboratorium]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://chg.kncv.nl/geschiedenis/biografieen/b/blasse,-g. |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190515104414/https://chg.kncv.nl/geschiedenis/biografieen/b/blasse,-g. |title=Blasse, G. |language=Dutch |publisher=Chemie Historische Groep |date= |archive-date=15 May 2019}}</ref> In 1970 he was appointed as professor of solid-state chemistry at Utrecht University. He retired in 1996.<ref name=uu/>

During his career he performed research into luminescent materials. He discovered the [[phosphor]] that made white light [[LED]]s possible.<ref name="schademann">{{cite web|last1=Schademann |first1=Beth |url=https://www.electrochem.org/ecsnews/cfp-jss-focus-issue-george-blasse |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230324225445/https://www.electrochem.org/ecsnews/cfp-jss-focus-issue-george-blasse |title=Focus Issue Dedicated to the Memory of George Blasse: Recent Developments in Theory, Materials, and Applications of Luminescence |publisher= |date=1 April 2021 |archive-date=24 March 2023}}</ref>

Blasse was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1982.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3880 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160617221015/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3880 |title=G. Blasse |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=17 June 2016 |accessdate=18 June 2016}}</ref> In 1992 he was awarded the academy's Gilles Holst Medal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/awards/laureates/gilles-holstfonds/overzicht |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200719201350/https://www.knaw.nl/en/awards/laureates/gilles-holstfonds/overzicht |title=Laureates Gilles Holst Medal |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=19 July 2020}}</ref> Blasse was elected a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] in 1993.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Blasse_George |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190328120630/https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Blasse_George |title=George Blasse |publisher=Academia Europaea |date= |archive-date=28 March 2019}}</ref> In 1996 he was made a Knight in the [[Order of the Netherlands Lion]].<ref>{{cite news|author= |url=http://www.nrc.nl/handelsblad/1996/04/26/lintjesregen-1996-onderscheiden-door-de-koningin-7307979 |title=Lintjesregen 1996; Onderscheiden door de Koningin |newspaper=NRC |language=Dutch |publisher=NRC Handelsblad |date=26 April 1996 |accessdate=18 June 2016}}</ref>

After his retirement he moved to [[Munich]], Germany.<ref name="schademann"/> He died there on 30 December 2020, aged 86.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://images.nrc.nl/bxLTFctBdtCiQ5VneseeEORSbJ4=/x/filters:no_upscale():format(jpeg):fill(f8f8f8,true)/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20210109/330-advertisement-221519_1274993_blasse01-13998b.png |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210109115307/https://images.nrc.nl/bxLTFctBdtCiQ5VneseeEORSbJ4=/x/filters:no_upscale%28%29:format%28jpeg%29:fill%28f8f8f8,true%29/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20210109/330-advertisement-221519_1274993_blasse01-13998b.png |title=George Blasse |language=nl |publisher=NRC Handelsblad |date=9 January 2021 |archive-date=9 January 2021}}</ref> After his death the ''[[ECS Journal of Solid State Science and Technology]]'' had a focus issue in his honor.<ref name="schademann"/>
